Texts and content of the public website: translations, browser page titles, FAQ, open positions, references and the knowledge base. Each part is a tab at the top.

The tab Knowledge base edits the public Help centre page (/knowledge-base). At the top is the introduction of the page - the main heading and the first text. Below it come the blocks in the order of the website: each block has a heading and a text, optionally any number of sub-blocks (smaller heading + text, button Add sub-block) and one optional image at the end. Blocks and sub-blocks can be added, moved and removed, and a block can be hidden (Show on the website).

Texts are entered for every language of the website separately (language switch at the top); each language shows the number of missing texts. Text changes are stored with Save, Discard returns the last saved state.

Image of a block: only JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB - no video or other files. The image is stored at once (without Save); the server scales it down, converts it to WebP and removes its metadata (e.g. the location). A new block has to be saved first, then its image can be uploaded.
Changes need the permission to edit the website; with read permission only the editor is read-only.
